Adopt four rules across the whole chrome. (1) HOVER = solid amber fill. Orange is hover, NOT toggled-on — easy to copy backwards; batch 08 proved it via frame 164000 where the New button is amber purely because the cursor is over it. (3) DISABLED = dimmed glyph, AND IT STILL SHOWS ITS TOOLTIP (verified on Redo) — a disabled control that explains itself is strictly better than one that goes silent.
